question.en: Simplify the following. $3\left(\left(\frac{7}{3}\right)x^2 - 25x + 12\right) - 7(x^2 + 8x - 16)$
question.hi: निम्नलिखित को सरल कीजिए: $3\left(\left(\frac{7}{3}\right)x^2 - 25x + 12\right) - 7(x^2 + 8x - 16)$

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**−131x + 148**).
solution.keyConcept: x² Term Cancellation + Sign Trap on −(−d)

optionTrick.en: Since $x^2$ terms cancel ($7x^2 - 7x^2 = 0$), check signs directly: $x$ term $= -75 - 56 = -131x$ (negative!) and constant $= +36 + 112 = +148$ (**positive!**). Sign pair `(−, +)` uniquely locks Option C!
optionTrick.hi: $x^2$ पद कटते हैं; $x$ गुणांक ऋणात्मक ($-131x$) व अचर पद धनात्मक ($+148$) होना तुरंत `(−, +)` चिह्न वाला विकल्प C पक्का करता है!

trapAlert.en: Beware double negative at the end: $-7 \times (-16) = +112$ (NOT $-112$!).
trapAlert.hi: अंतिम पद का चिह्न जाल: $-7 \times (-16) = +112$ (धनात्मक!) होता है।

steps.en:
1) Expand first bracket: $7x^2 - 75x + 36$.
2) Expand second bracket: $-7x^2 - 56x + 112$.
3) Combine like terms: $(7 - 7)x^2 + (-75 - 56)x + (36 + 112) = \mathbf{-131x + 148}$.

title.en: Method 2: Put x = 0 & Sign Check (5 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: x = 0 व चिह्न नियम ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Full Bracket Expansion: 1) Expand first bracket: $7x^2 - 75x + 36$.
2) Expand second bracket: $-7x^2 - 56x + 112$.
3) Combine like terms: $(7 - 7)x^2 + (-75 - 56)x + (36 + 112) = \mathbf{-131x + 148}$.

Method 2: Put x = 0 & Sign Check (5 sec): Put $x = 0$: $3(12) - 7(-16) = 36 + 112 = +148$. Since both $x$ terms are negative ($-75x - 56x$), only `−131x + 148` has `(−x, +148)`!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: पूर्ण कोष्ठक विस्तार विधि: 1) पहला कोष्ठक: $7x^2 - 75x + 36$।
2) दूसरा कोष्ठक: $-7x^2 - 56x + 112$।
3) सजातीय पद मिलाने पर $= \mathbf{-131x + 148}$।

विधि 2: x = 0 व चिह्न नियम ट्रिक: $x = 0$ रखने पर अचर $= +36 + 112 = +148$ व दोनों $x$-पद ऋणात्मक ($-75x - 56x = -131x$) $\Rightarrow$ तुरंत **−131x + 148**!

question.en: Find the value of 55 −6÷ 555× 55−8.

solution.keyConcept: Same-Base Index Law: a^m ÷ a^n = a^(m−n) and a^m × a^n = a^(m+n)

optionTrick.en: Subtract exponent after `÷`, add exponent after `×`: $-6 - (5) + (-8) = -19 \Rightarrow \mathbf{55^{-19}}$!

trapAlert.en: Work strictly Left-to-Right for ÷ and × (`a^m ÷ a^n × a^k = a^(m − n + k)`), NOT multiplying right-hand terms before dividing!

steps.en: Sum signed exponents directly on base 55: $-6 - (5) + (-8) = -19 \Rightarrow \mathbf{55^{-19}}$.
steps.hi: आधार 55 की सभी घातें एक पंक्ति में हल करें: $-6 - (5) + (-8) = -19 \Rightarrow \mathbf{55^{-19}}$।

solution.en:
Method 1: Step-by-Step Laws of Indices: 1) First two terms: $55^{-6 - (5)} = 55^{-11}$.
2) Combine third term: $55^{-11 + (-8)} = \mathbf{55^{-19}}$.

Method 2: Single-Line Exponent Sum (4 sec): Sum signed exponents directly on base 55: $-6 - (5) + (-8) = -19 \Rightarrow \mathbf{55^{-19}}$.

solution.keyConcept: Two-Stage Simple Interest (Fractional Years + Final Amount)

title.en: Method 1: Convert Mixed Fractions & Solve P First
title.hi: विधि 1: मिश्र भिन्न बदलकर मूलधन P व नया मिश्रधन निकालें
विधि 2: प्रतिशत अनुपात सीधा गुणक ट्रिक

solution.en:

2) $P = \frac{8778 \times 100}{19} = 46,200$.
3) $T_2 = 2\frac{5}{7} = \frac{19}{7}$ yrs $\Rightarrow R_2 T_2 = 5.5 \times \frac{19}{7} = 14.9286\%$.
4) $SI_2 = 46,200 \times 14.9286\% = 6,897 \Rightarrow A_2 = 46,200 + 6,897 = \mathbf{53,097}$.

Method 2: Direct Multiplier Factor Ratio: $1\%$ of $P = \frac{8778}{19} = 462$. Since Amount $= 114.9286\%$, directly compute $462 \times 114.9286 = \mathbf{53,097}$.

solution.keyConcept: Principal from SI Amount: A = (100 + R×T)% of P
